notes.text: Scan 031, with lower footer number 30 and no upper manuscript page number, states that the canonical map (37) between the compactified multiplicities is a closed immersion of proper smooth schematic multiplicities over Z. It describes the closure of M_[G] inside the ambient compactification and says the specialization types [G′] are those arising from M̂_G. The author inserts “a priori” before “curieux !” and says the construction will now be revisited. The word before this insertion remains uncertain because of retraced ink. No date appears. These statements have been transcribed, not proved or independently checked.
